authored_narrative.episode_purpose: The open meadow that once measured isolation and, later, simple openness, appears a third time carrying neither meaning — just a place Gonagi and Dana happen to be, together, without the scene needing to argue for anything.

scene_spirited_away_meadow_flower_0044.purpose: No threshold to cross, no labor to share, no isolation to answer — the meadow finally gets to be only a meadow, and that itself is the point this late in the Story.
scene_spirited_away_meadow_flower_0044.stakes: whether a scene can hold real weight without conflict driving it
scene_spirited_away_meadow_flower_0044.opposing_force: the habit of expecting every space in this Story to mean something, even after eight episodes of evidence that not every space still needs to

scene_spirited_away_dragon_flight_0045.purpose: A brief, unremarkable moment of motion — not a crossing, not a threshold, not a callback waiting to happen. Two people moving through a space together, which by now is simply what they do.
scene_spirited_away_dragon_flight_0045.stakes: whether the relationship needs anything left to demonstrate at all
scene_spirited_away_dragon_flight_0045.opposing_force: none — this scene is deliberately the first in the Story with no opposing force to name

shot_spirited_00345.intent: A loose, unhurried frame with no particular subject held — the composition itself relaxes, matching the scene's lack of stakes.

shot_spirited_00353.intent: A short, plain traveling shot — no echo of an earlier composition this time, because the moment doesn't need one to justify its place in the Story.
